constraints.name: ci_checkout_jobs_check

constraints.definition: CHECK (((plan IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(plan) = 'object'::text) AND (plan ?& ARRAY['version'::text, 'job_id'::text, 'owner_id'::text, 'repository_id'::text, 'storage_generation'::text, 'object_format'::text, 'target_oid'::text, 'source_receipt_sha256'::text, 'mirror_audience'::text, 'expires_unix'::text]) AND (octet_length((plan)::text) <= 8192) AND ((plan -> 'version'::text) = '1'::jsonb) AND ((plan -> 'job_id'::text) = to_jsonb((job_id)::text)) AND ((plan -> 'owner_id'::text) = to_jsonb((owner_id)::text)) AND ((plan -> 'repository_id'::text) = to_jsonb((repository_id)::text)) AND (jsonb_typeof((plan -> 'storage_generation'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((plan ->> 'storage_generation'::text) ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'::text) AND ((plan -> 'object_format'::text) = '"sha1"'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((plan -> 'target_oid'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (((plan ->> 'target_oid'::text) COLLATE "C") ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'::text) AND ((plan ->> 'target_oid'::text) <> repeat('0'::text, 40)) AND (jsonb_typeof((plan -> 'source_receipt_sha256'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (((plan ->> 'source_receipt_sha256'::text) COLLATE "C") ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((plan -> 'mirror_audience'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (((plan ->> 'mirror_audience'::text) COLLATE "C") ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) AND ((plan -> 'expires_unix'::text) = to_jsonb(expires_unix)))))
